stemMarkdown: Two positive numbers add up to 34. What is the maximum possible value of their product?
solutionMarkdown: By AM-GM, for a fixed sum the product is largest when the numbers are equal. Each is $\dfrac{34}{2} = 17.0$, so the maximum product is $17.0 \times 17.0 = 289.0$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equality in AM-GM always happens when the terms are equal — that is what makes it an optimisation tool.
